name: pi-ytmusic-receiver
description: YouTube Music (DIAL + Lounge) cast receiver playing into the PipeWire audio router's RTP source, via mpv
comment: Pinned to yt-cast-receiver 2.x. NOTE: npm's latest is 2.1.0; a local git checkout may say 2.1.1 (unreleased master) — do not pin to that, it does not resolve. 2.1.0 was checked to carry everything used here: dial.bindToAddresses, the nine Player abstract methods, and Constants.CLIENTS.
